namespace TestApp;

/// <summary>
/// Extension methods for registering services discovered by the source generator.
/// </summary>
public static partial class ServiceRegistrationExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Registers all services marked with [Service] attribute.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">The service collection.</param>

    public static IServiceCollection AddPragmaticServices(this IServiceCollection services)
